findings.claim: F-GPS-LOGIC (CW-F04B) misses the window-edge logic D29 names ('window edges'). The rules treat the driver as present across an unobserved change of position at a window edge. One case: the last ping at the pin is more than TS_TOLERANCE_S before the window end and the next ping is outside, more than TS_TOLERANCE_S after the window end. The other: a real departure before the window start, with the driver first seen back more than TS_TOLERANCE_S into the window. In both, F-GPS-LOGIC is false at the base values and at every parameter end, so the fee is upheld at AUTO. A shorter or earlier-detected version of the same pattern goes to approval through GPS_AMBIGUOUS. The presence logic predates A3 (the de53c7c engine gives the same AUTO), but A3's F-GPS-LOGIC was meant to cover it. The same hole reaches waiting fees through the rule text.
findings.evidence:
Engine line 691: `elif not r["outlier"] and r not in left_runs and start <= t_first <= wend + timedelta(seconds=tol) and t_prev < wend - timedelta(seconds=tol)`. The CW-F04B text matches it: 'first seen outside between the window start and TS_TOLERANCE_S after the window end' and 'Only pings inside the window decide the value; pings outside it only show where a stretch begins and whether the driver came back.' D29: 'whenever upholding a fee depends on FairRyde's own GPS logic (outliers, window edges, ...)'.

Runs (full E.run):
- C49: UPHOLD, R8, AUTO, GL=False, no sensitivity GL.
- C49b, the same with the away ping at 08:46:25: R11, APPROVE, GPS_AMBIGUOUS.
- C45b: R8, AUTO.
- C45a, the same 60 s dropout after a 15 s outlier stretch: R11, APPROVE, GPS_AMBIGUOUS.
- C45c: R8, AUTO.
- WF-4 (E07 proxy): R8, AUTO.
- WF-4b: R11, APPROVE.
- The de53c7c engine also gives AUTO for C45b, C45c and C46.

The explanation sent for C49 says: 'This decision was made automatically ... Every driver GPS point from 08:43:00 to 08:46:00 is at the pick-up pin, and the longest stretch without a point at the pin is 60 seconds ... After the counted wait ended at 08:46:00, the driver's GPS was away from the pick-up pin (E-GPS-12); the fee pays for the wait up to that point, so this is not counted as leaving.'

The project's own fuzz generator produces this shape: in /tmp/a3check2/oracle_fuzz.py (1,500 cases, seed 21), 8 of the 37 AUTO upholds have it. fuzz_presence.check only inspects outside pings up to `wend + timedelta(seconds=TOL)` and never generates advance bookings.
findings.failure_scenario:
C49 (no-show): V06 baseline changed to the Ryde profile:
- cancellation_policy removed, booking_type ON_DEMAND, NON_CONTESTING description;
- cancellation moved to 08:47:00; platform check at 08:43:00 kept;
- driver pings at the pin every 20 s from 08:43:00 to 08:45:00, then one ping 400 m north at 08:46:40.
The window is 08:43:00 to 08:46:00. The engine upholds at R8, tier AUTO, although the pings cannot show more than 120 s of waiting at the pick-up. Moving the away ping earlier, to 08:46:25, gives approval.

C45c (no-show): Ryde advance booking for 08:45, arrival 08:38 with the platform check, cancellation 08:48:10. Pings every 10 s at the pin until 08:40:00, 400 m north from 08:40:20 to 08:44:50, back at the pin from 08:45:50. The engine counts the window from 08:45:00 as presence and upholds at R8, AUTO. At urban speeds the driver cannot have waited 180 s at the pick-up.

WF-4 (waiting fee, from E07): free wait 10:14:30 to 10:17:30. Pings at the pin every 20 s until 10:16:50, one ping 400 m away at 10:18:10, at the pin from 10:19:00 until boarding at 10:21:10. CW-F04B as written gives CONSISTENT. The away ping is set aside but not counted, and GPS_AMBIGUOUS needs it by 10:18:00. So F-GPS-LOGIC is false at every parameter end, AUTH-02 trigger 12 does not fire, and an LLM applier upholds at AUTO.

The pattern is rare: it needs a dropout of 60 to 90 s straddling the threshold, or an advance-booking driver who leaves and returns 30 to 60 s after the scheduled time.
findings.suggested_fix:
In CW-F04B's F-GPS-LOGIC (or in GPS_AMBIGUOUS), and in the engine, add two conditions:
(a) the last inside ping in the window is more than TS_TOLERANCE_S before the window end and the next ping is outside, whenever it comes before the cancellation or boarding. That is, drop the 'TS_TOLERANCE_S after the window end' cap on the first outside ping.
(b) the window starts after the confirmed arrival, the last ping before the window start is outside and not set aside, and the first inside ping comes more than TS_TOLERANCE_S after the window start.
Add self-test variants for C49 and C45b. Extend fuzz_presence to advance bookings and to outside pings after wend + TS_TOLERANCE_S. In explain.py, the after-window sentence should not imply the driver left after the counted wait when the last inside ping is more than TS_TOLERANCE_S before its end.
